per_ticket.customer_message:
From: carol@example.com
Subject: How do I reset my password?

Hi, I can't log in and forgot my password. How do I reset it?
per_ticket.final_draft:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out — happy to help you get back in.

To reset your password, go to the ACME login page and click the "Forgot password?" link. Enter the email address associated with your account, and we'll send you a reset link. Just follow the link in that email to set a new password.

If the reset email doesn't arrive within a few minutes, check your spam or junk folder. And if you run into any trouble at all, just reply here and we'll sort it out with you.

Best,
ACME Support team
